exact_theorem: For every odd n>1 divisible by three, Sz(2^n) is the full automorphism group of a thin, residually connected, flag-transitive rank-three geometry with pentagonal rank-two residues, full correlation group G semidirect C3, and no dualities.
qualification: Separately accepted generation repair is part of that current L015 result. Distinct n give different group orders, hence infinitely many geometries. This answers the broad final question of L023, not a rank-four-specific strengthening.
